ops.text: 7.7 No liquidated damages and no penalties are payable by Customer under this Agreement.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept liquidated damages payable by us, and 15% of annual Fees per week for a ten-day payment delay would exceed the contract value within weeks. We have deleted Section 7.7 and replaced it with a short prohibition on Customer-payable liquidated damages and penalties, leaving Vendor's existing remedies in Section 7 and Section 9 untouched.
proposal.summary: Delete the Customer-payable liquidated damages clause and state that no liquidated damages or penalties are payable by Customer
